summary: Verified admin-only document locking across Estimates, Sales Orders, and Invoices. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passing — admin can edit non-customer fields and duplicate; admin PUT with a different customer_id returns 400 and customer binding is unchanged; salesman direct PUT, POST duplicate, and PATCH status (SO + Invoice) all return 403; salesman work-status PATCH on all three doc types returns 200. Frontend: salesman action menus for Estimates/SOs expose only Print/Email/COD/Approve|Convert (no Edit, no Create a copy); salesman has no edit-estimate/edit-so/duplicate-* buttons; salesman number cells for Estimates and Sales Orders do not open an editor (no save-doc-btn, no URL change). Admin edit screen renders doc-customer SearchSelect with disabled=true. Mobile viewport (390px) shows no page-level horizontal overflow on /estimates, /sales-orders, or /invoices (doc.scrollWidth equals window width).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~6880 lines). Consider splitting into modules (estimates/sales_orders/invoices/auth/etc.) for maintainability — not blocking.
No GET-by-id endpoint for /estimates/{id}, /sales-orders/{id}, /invoices/{id} (returns 405). Not required for this task but would simplify client fetches and tests.
seed_data_creation: Three temporary documents (1 estimate, 1 sales order, 1 invoice titled TEST_locking_doc) and admin-duplicated copies were created and all deleted by the pytest fixture teardown using admin password confirmation. No stray TEST_ documents or customers remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Document customer-lock + salesman restriction behavior is enforced server-side (routes use require_admin for PUT/duplicate/status and reject customer_id change with 400). Frontend DocBuilder.jsx disables doc-customer when editing (initial truthy). Salesman list pages hide edit/duplicate actions and the number cells no longer open an editor. Mobile tables are wrapped so page-level horizontal overflow is absent.
